Proficio 

Advancing the Global 
Mission of MDR 

We make the world safer by protecting organizations from cyber threats with world-class managed detection and response services 24/7, 365 days a year. 

WHO WE ARE 

Founded in 2010, Proficio is a leading managed detection and response (MDR) service provider, delivering advanced MDR services to organizations around the world. 
As the inventor of SOC-as-a-Service, cybersecurity business intelligence, and automated response, Proficio was created with one purpose: to advance the global mission of managed detection and response. Proficio provides 24/7 security monitoring and alerting from its global security operations centers (SOCs) in San Diego, Barcelona, and Singapore and has been recognized in Gartner’s Market Guide for MDR services annually since 2017. 

OUR MISSION 

Organizations face increasingly sophisticated cyber threats every day. The disruption and damage caused by cyberattacks and breaches can destroy businesses — and ruin lives. For this reason, Proficio is dedicated to developing and providing advanced MDR services around the clock, 365 days a year. By protecting businesses and organizations from ever-evolving cyber threats, we not only reduce the risk of breaches, we also create a safer world.

Our Story 

Proficio was founded with one purpose: to advance the global mission of Managed Detection and Response (MDR). 

Recognizing the ever-shifting threats in the digital realm, we embarked on a mission to equip companies, regardless of their size, with the advanced capabilities and top-tier quality of SOC services typically associated with Fortune 10 companies, all delivered through a shared service model tailored to each customer. 
Over the years, Proficio has been at the forefront of innovation, consistently adapting to the dynamic cybersecurity landscape. Our journey is marked by a series of pioneering initiatives. We invented SOC-as-a-Service before MDR was a recognized industry term; we figured out how to transform billions of gigabytes of data and threat intelligence into valuable cybersecurity business intelligence IT leaders can use to make  smarter and faster decisions on their cybersecurity investments and we were the first MDR provider to deliver true automated threat response capabilities.  
We take pride in our legacy of innovation and commitment to cybersecurity excellence, staying ahead of emerging threats and technology trends. Today, our story continues as we remain dedicated to advancing the global mission of MDR.  

Core Values 

At Proficio, we prioritize excellence, collaboration, transparency, and flexibility. 
These values underpin our commitment to delivering world-class cybersecurity services and building lasting partnerships with our clients 

Our Leadership Team 

Get to know our leadership team, they’re some of the best and brightest around. 

Meet our Leaders 

What Sets Us Apart From Other MDR Providers 

Expertise & Innovation

Put Our Frontline Experience and Expertise at Work for You 

With over 14 years at the forefront of cybersecurity services, we lead in innovation, inventing the ground-breaking MDR solutions such as SOC-as-a-Service, automated threat response, and cybersecurity business intelligence. 

Our Legacy of Innovation 

Before the acronyms MDR and SOAR were created, Proficio was providing these services under the term SOC-as-a-Service. 

Cybersecurity Business Intelligence 

Another capability that was derived from our philosophy of innovation, is the development and availability of rich and insightful business intelligence for cybersecurity leaders, serving them data about the operations and health of their security environment and programs. 

Our Industry Certifications 

We Are Certified to the Highest Standards 

Recognizing the importance of information security and the daily trust our clients place in us, we maintain alignment and compliance with the highest level of international standards, including SOC 2 Type II Certification, ISO 27001:2013 certification, and Singapore Government MSSP Certified SOC. These certifications serve as a testament to our commitment to excellence in advancing the global mission of Managed Detection and Response, and are emblematic of our dedication to upholding the highest international standards for data protection for our company and our clients across the globe.

Adaptability & Collaboration 

Better Together 

Supporting 350+ log sources and integrations with major security tools and technologies, we ensure flexibility and efficiency, seamlessly integrating with your existing IT environment and tools.

Customer-Centric Excellence 

Our success is intrinsically tied to the success and security of our clients. Our record of achievement stands as a testament to our ability to fulfill our promise – safeguarding our customers round the clock, 365 days a year, with the best MDR services available throughout our partnership while delivering effective outcomes at an affordable value. 

Cloud or Hybrid 

Our managed detection and response services can be delivered using our fully hosted cloud-based platform or we can co-manage a client’s existing security tools infrastructure. 

Our Culture 

Proficio is characterized by passion, innovation, and transparency and driven by our relentless pursuit to achieve higher excellence standards,acting as an extension of your team, working collaboratively to achieve mutual success. As a true partner, we are dedicated to delivering effective outcomes while maintaining affordability. Join our team and be part of a culture that values innovation, expertise, and a holistic approach to cybersecurity.
